question.problem:
Consider the LU decomposition of the matrix $A$ and the vector $b,$ given by

$$
A={{[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{L}{{[\begin{aligned}-3 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{U},\,b=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -3\end{aligned}].
$$

If $⟨{x}_{1},{x}_{2}⟩$ and $⟨{y}_{1},{y}_{2}⟩$ are the solutions to the systems $Ax=b$ and $Ly=b$ respectively, what is the value of $\sqrt{{x}_{1}^{2}+{y}_{2}^{2}}?$
question.worked_solution:
First, notice that since $A=LU,$ we can write

$$
\begin{aligned}Ax=b\,⟹\,{{(LU)}_{⏟}}_{A}x=b.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, setting $Ux=y,$ we obtain

$$
L{{(Ux)}_{⏟}}_{y}=b\,⟹\,\{\begin{aligned}Ly=b \\ Ux=y.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we solve the two systems in turn.

- First, we solve $Ly=b.$ Writing this equation in matrix form, we get

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}]=b=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -3\end{aligned}].
$$

This gives the system of equations

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{y}_{1}=3 \\ 3{y}_{1}+{y}_{2}=-3.\end{aligned}
$$

The solution to this system is ${y}_{1}=3$ and ${y}_{2}=-12.$ Therefore, 

$$
y=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -12\end{aligned}].
$$

- Next, we solve $Ux=y.$ Writing this equation in matrix form, we get

$$
[\begin{aligned}-3 & 1 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]=y=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -12\end{aligned}].
$$

This gives the system of equations

$$
\{\begin{aligned}-3{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=3 \\ {x}_{2}=-12.\end{aligned}
$$

The solution to this system is ${x}_{2}=-12$ and ${x}_{1}=-5.$ Therefore, 

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ -12\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, 

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt{{x}_{1}^{2}+{y}_{2}^{2}} & =\sqrt{(-5)^{2}+(-12)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{25+144} \\  & =\sqrt{169} \\  & =13.\end{aligned}
$$
